name: What is the typical process for designing and building a Detached ADU?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for designing and building a Detached ADU?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process for a Detached ADU begins with an initial consultation to understand your vision and assess your property's potential. AKN Design Group then moves into comprehensive design planning, including CAD-supported layouts and material selections, followed by meticulous permit coordination. Once permits are secured, our experienced team manages all construction phases, from foundation to final finishes. This integrated design-build approach ensures a seamless, managed process from concept to completion, with clear communication and a single point of coordination throughout the project.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves consultation, design planning with CAD layouts, permit coordination, and comprehensive construction management, all guided by AKN Design Group's integrated approach.
